sibling.check: python -m pytest -q in the sibling folder; PRD facts below read from its git diff

audit: Per-repo state: each repository has its own state or changes folder (`.claude/prd-flow/state/<slug>` or `changes/NNN-<slug>`) with its own rows; the orders state does not hold storefront rows.

Dispatch to the other repository carries only the request and the approved rows, quoting the user's words; no domain assumption of the chief (for example how the first name is derived, or that the storefront must change first).
A prompt to an agent of the sibling names the repository by alias or path and no agent edits the other repository's files.
The orders repository does not restate CUS rules and the storefront repository does not restate CHK rules.

prd_facts.fact: The receipt carries a customer name field with the name as received from the caller, and an empty string when none was sent.
A missing or empty customer name is never an error in the orders service.
The receipt text layout and as_dict do not change.
The orders service does not split or derive the name; the storefront builds it.
Applies to every order from now on, with no flag and no migration.
